newsitem.title: CHINA: China Founder wins $2.1 mln new order.
newsitem.headline: China Founder wins $2.1 mln new order.

text.p: China's Beijing University Founder Group Corp has won a $2.1 million order to provide Chinese electronic publishing systems to a Malaysian newspaper group, the Beijing Daily said on Friday.
Founder finalised the deal during a recent trade fair in Guangzhou, capital of the southern province of Guangdong, it said.
Founder (Hong Kong), a unit of Beijing University Founder Group, is the dominant player in the Chinese electronic publishing software with an estimated market share of 70 percent.
